Where We're Staying

Hilton Aruba Caribbean Resort & Casino

Set on fifteen tropical acres along Aruba's famous Palm Beach, the Hilton Aruba just wrapped a multi million dollar renovation, and it shows. Every one of the 357 rooms and suites has a private balcony or patio, plus the modern touches you'd expect, including fast Wi-Fi and a 50 inch HDTV.

Spend your days by one of two pools, in a palapa on Aruba's longest stretch of beach, or exploring the resort's restaurants and bars, from the Sunset Grille to Gilligan's Seafood Shack.

  • •Sunset Grille — steaks and fresh seafood
  • •Laguna — nightly themed buffets
  • •Gilligan's — casual dining and drinks

A Few Things to Know Before You Book

The Basics

  • Rooms are confirmed first come, first served, so request your quote early for the best shot at your preferred room type
  • A one night deposit per room secures your reservation. Because the amount depends on your dates, room type, and travelers, it will be spelled out clearly in your personalized quote
  • Bring the same card used to book for check in verification

What Your Daily Resort Charge Covers

Subject to change at the resort's discretion

  • Guest Wi-Fi
  • Non-motorized water sports, kayaks, and paddle boards
  • Yoga, meditation, and dance sessions
  • Mini spa experiences and fitness activities
  • Bike rentals and reusable water bottles

What's Included in Your Stay

  • Room stay, taxes, and resort fees
  • Birthday group perk: breakfast for two, per room
  • Birthday group perk: $50 resort credit, per room

Plan Ahead For

  • Flights
  • Travel protection (optional, see below)
  • Round trip group airport transfers — offered as an add-on, priced once flights are booked

Getting Ready for Aruba

  • Kariann will send along travel guidance and tips as your trip gets closer
  • Complete Aruba's online Embarkation and Disembarkation card at edcardaruba.aw. This includes a $20 per person sustainability fee.
  • Your passport needs to be free of damage and valid at least 6 months past your return date.
  • Flying into Aruba's AUA airport. Book on your own, and we recommend booking directly with the airline for flexibility
  • Arriving before your room is ready? Pack your swimsuit in your carry on and dive straight into resort life

Protecting Your Trip

Travel insurance isn't required, but we always recommend it for international trips. If you'd like to add it, we'll build it into your quote for review. You can also call the insurance provider directly with your quote ID at 1-800-243-3174. Coverage is non-refundable, and since Zotto Travel isn't the insurance provider, any claims go straight to the company listed on your policy.
